offence_note: Possession of loaded handgun in vehicle
sentence_quote: A six-year sentence was, as acknowledged by the Crown, at the higher end of the range, but we are not persuaded that it was outside the range.
note: Conviction and sentence appeals dismissed; one-for-one credit for five months.

sentence_quote: This, coupled with a similarly poor record for non-compliance with court orders relating to compliance with recognizances, terms of probation and one of failure to comply with a disposition, merit the sentence of 18 months imprisonment.
note: Exact offence not named; domestic violence implies assault-type offence.

sentence_quote: Therefore, giving effect to the trial judge's intent, we increase the credit given to the appellant for pre-trial custody by a further 17 months.
note: Sentence length and offences not shown; credit increased by further 17 months; Gladue error conceded but no weight stated.

offence_note: Possession of stolen car, dangerous driving, drug possession
sentence_quote: In my view, there is simply no foundation for this court to say, for someone with this criminal record, that the sentence imposed by the learned trial judge was not in accordance with the principles of sentencing.
note: Highest sentence 9 months; global total not given. Leave to appeal refused.

sentence_quote: In summary, I would allow the Crown's appeal and increase the five-year sentence to one of seven years' imprisonment.
note: Seven years stated after giving credit for time served; credit amount unclear (5 months dead time at trial).

offence_note: Dangerous weapon possession, prohibited knives, driving while prohibited
sentence_quote: I would allow the appeal by reducing the global net sentence by one year from three years and two weeks' imprisonment to two years and two weeks' imprisonment.
note: Global 2.5 years before credit; two-for-one credit applied at trial; mitigating was admissions at trial.

offence_note: Multiple sexual offences against six-year-old son
sentence_quote: The appellant was sentenced to five years imprisonment with ancillary prohibition orders.
note: Only ancillary order varied: lifetime 2 km ban became 15 years; under-16 communication ban deleted.

offence_note: Possession of cocaine for the purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: The sentence of 18 months imposed by the trial judge was within the range and it was open to the trial judge to find that this was not an appropriate case for a conditional sentence.

offence_note: Making, possessing and distributing obscene material
sentence_quote: He was sentenced to a fine of $28,000, two years of probation with conditions including 240 hours of community service, and repayment of the fine during the probationary period.

sentence_quote: After credit for pre‑trial custody, I sentence you to an additional prison term of three years and three months.
